discrepancies.description: PHASE8_ARCHITECTURE_REPORT.md Line 10 recorded Colab zip SHA256 as 'f798e9d252ec6124b276a241e7665dac7ba51f8fd0eb1a80adafa0a24b7771b3', whereas Section 5 Line 150 recorded '7a9ec59feed6a327d2ed0c9c2cffd198afbd3314a14b786c02e20ecba884ab40'.
discrepancies.cause: The package builder was executed a second time after Section 6 was appended, updating the zip content and size (from 202,597 to 205,022 bytes). Section 5 was updated but Line 10 header retained the previous hash.

discrepancies.description: colab/COLAB_PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json contains an entry for itself with sha256 'c03dd8de1be951724b7fb92c7a4c1a91faf2d279720ab99b78e1017ba88f0b20', whereas the packed manifest file has sha256 '99196b0d3db32a578a6772c3d35a953491ca0fc964e23bfe59ac8e7daf567531'.
discrepancies.cause: The manifest calculates file hashes prior to packaging and includes a pre-computed entry for itself, which is inherently altered when the manifest is serialized.
discrepancies.impact: All other 64 packaged files have 100% exact matching hashes. Only the manifest's self-entry has a circular hash discrepancy.

discrepancies.description: summary_config_e_autonomous.json reports total_duration_s = 4148.3s, whereas the sum of individual task duration_s in evaluation_results_config_e_autonomous.json is 3999.26s.
discrepancies.cause: summary_config_e_autonomous.json records total benchmark wall-clock execution time (including model loading, temporary directory setup/teardown, indexer scans, and inter-task garbage collection), whereas per-task duration_s measures only the active run_task execution window.

discrepancies.category: Multi-File Atomic Rollback Scope in Benchmark
discrepancies.description: The architecture report stated that atomic rollback was verified on 100% of multi-file failures. However, in the benchmark run (Tasks 11-15), Step 1 failed during proposal dry-run validation (session.step()) before any patch was approved or applied to disk.
discrepancies.cause: completed_files was empty ([]). While _rollback(snapshot) was called, no target files had been mutated on disk in the benchmark. Rollback of actual file mutations was proven in unit test test_multi_file_orchestrator_atomic_rollback, but was NOT exercised on disk in the benchmark.
discrepancies.evidence_status: Rollback capability VERIFIED in unit tests; NOT EXERCISED on disk in benchmark tasks 11-15.

discrepancies.category: Component Persistence Inactivity in Benchmark Loop
discrepancies.description: eval_results_phase8/storage_config_e_autonomous/ was created but remained empty ([]). No repair experiences were ingested to repair_memory.json, and no strategy statistics were saved to strategy_stats.json.
discrepancies.cause: In app/engineering_loop.py, RepairMemory and StrategySelector were instantiated without passing enabled=self.memory_enabled and enabled=self.strategy_enabled. Their internal is_enabled() checks defaulted to config.json ('MEMORY_ENABLED': false, 'STRATEGY_LEARNING_ENABLED': false), causing add_verified_experience() and record_outcome() to early-return.
discrepancies.impact: Strategy prompts WERE selected and injected into model context, and memory retrieval WAS attempted. However, cross-task learning and memory growth were inactive during the benchmark.

discrepancies.description: The report header cited 'Model Identifier: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct (Local CPU / Colab T4)'.
discrepancies.cause: Raw stdout in the task result JSON (platform win32, Python 3.10.11, rootdir: C:\Users\T14s\AppData\Local\Temp\...) proves that the benchmark was executed entirely on a Windows local CPU environment. There is no evidence of Colab T4 GPU execution for this run.
discrepancies.reconciled_fact: Benchmark run was 100% local Windows CPU.
